sources.entry: LLM Harbor - Containerized LLM toolkit. Run LLM backends, APIs, frontends, and additional services via a concise CLI. Apache-2.0 Docker/Shell

summary.one_liner: Harbor is a CLI and companion app for spinning up a complete local LLM stack, with backends, frontends and supporting services pre-wired together via Docker Compose.
summary.what_it_does: Harbor provides a single `harbor` CLI that starts LLM backends (such as Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, TGI, and SGLang) and frontends (such as Open WebUI) with `harbor up`, handling Docker Compose orchestration and cross-service connectivity. Optional satellite services such as SearXNG (web search for RAG), Speaches (voice chat), ComfyUI (image generation), and Boost (a proxy/workflow module) can be added in the same command. It includes a `harbor launch` command that points host coding CLIs (e.g., Codex, OpenCode, Claude) at a Harbor OpenAI-compatible backend. The README also documents config profiles, command history, QR/LAN URLs, a tunneling command, and an `eject` command that exports a standalone docker-compose file. On macOS, some backends (Docker Model Runner, MLX, oMLX) run host-native with Metal acceleration.
use_cases: run a local LLM stack with one command
chat with local models in a web UI
add web search to a local chatbot
set up voice chat with a local LLM
generate images with FLUX in Open WebUI
point coding agents at a local model
export a local stack to docker-compose
notable: Single CLI orchestrates dozens of LLM backends and frontends with pre-wired connections
harbor launch wires a Harbor backend into host coding tools like Codex and OpenCode
harbor eject exports a standalone docker-compose file for moving off Harbor
Host-native Metal inference on macOS via Docker Model Runner, MLX, and oMLX
Built-in tunneling and traefik integration for exposing services
caveats: The README warns that exposing services to the internet is unsafe and authentication must be configured first
Harbor is described as a development/experimentation helper, not a deployment solution
Some features are macOS-specific (Metal acceleration via host-native backends)
